metadata.title: When is a polynomial in three variables cylindrical?
metadata.abstract: We prove that a nonconstant polynomial $f\in\mathbb{C}[x_1,x_2,x_3]$ is cylindrical (that is, $f\in\mathbb{C}[x_1,x_2]$ after an invertible linear change of coordinates) if and only if its bordered Hessian determinant vanishes identically. The same conclusion holds over $\mathbb{R}$. We also give explicit counterexamples to this criterion in every dimension $n\ge4$.

analysis.workSummary: 证明三变量实或复非恒定多项式可经可逆线性换元化为仅依赖两个变量，当且仅当其加边 Hessian 行列式恒为零，并在所有更高维构造反例。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出三维中可计算的充要判据，并明确其高维失效。
analysis.limitations: 柱状性按线性换元理解，不涉及任意多项式自同构；n≥4 不可直接沿用此判据。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Kimi 协助定位文献，ChatGPT 找到早稿错误并简化定理1证明的步骤4，Codex 辅助表述、LaTeX 编辑、数学及引文检查和编译核对。
